Inspect saved OPeNDAP subset acquisition

Source: R/opendap-acquisition.R
subset_status.Rd

These views read only the local acquisition manifest. They never contact an ESGF index or data node, and data-node observations retain their client and age.

subset_status(
  dest,
  view = c("summary", "blocks", "attempts", "nodes", "links", "candidates", "coverage",
    "timing"),
  source_key = NULL
)

Arguments

dest

Acquisition directory returned by fetch_subset().

view

One of summary, blocks, attempts, nodes, links, candidates, coverage or timing.

source_key

Optional source identities limiting coverage/timing inspection.

Value

A summary list or a data.table of local manifest records. Summary directory_complete reports whether every saved request originated from a fully collected File directory. NA denotes missing directory evidence, including acquisition manifests created before this field was recorded. Coverage reports each saved request's checked native expected/available value counts, four-corner completion and retry eligibility. Unknown axes retain NA counts; native missing values are not scientific qualification. Timing separates recorded open/metadata/data phases from whole failed tasks, whose duration may include useful partial reads and must not be added again. Call these views only while the acquisition writer is closed.
